mapper.select: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(good_quantity + bad_quantity), 0) FROM production_report WHERE report_date = CURDATE()
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM work_order WHERE status = 1
SELECT status as status, COUNT(*) as count FROM work_order GROUP BY status ORDER BY status
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM quality_task WHERE status = 0
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM stock_info WHERE quantity < 100

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(report_date, '%m-%d') as date, COALESCE(SUM(good_quantity), 0) as value FROM production_report WHERE report_date >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 6 DAY) GROUP BY report_date ORDER BY report_date

SELECT p.product_name as name, SUM(r.good_quantity + r.bad_quantity) as value FROM production_report r JOIN work_order w ON r.work_order_id = w.id JOIN product_info p ON w.product_id = p.id WHERE r.report_date >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 30 DAY) GROUP BY p.product_name ORDER BY value DESC LIMIT 5

SELECT COALESCE(SUM(total), 0) as total, COALESCE(SUM(pass), 0) as pass, COALESCE(SUM(fail), 0) as fail FROM (SELECT COUNT(*) as total, SUM(CASE WHEN result = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as pass, SUM(CASE WHEN result = 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as fail FROM quality_result) t

SELECT id, order_no as title, 'order_approval' as type, 'pending' as status, DATE_FORMAT(create_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') as createTime FROM order_customer WHERE status = 0 ORDER BY create_time DESC LIMIT 10

SELECT id, purchase_no as title, 'purchase_arrival' as type, 'pending' as status, DATE_FORMAT(create_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') as createTime FROM purchase_order WHERE status = 2 ORDER BY create_time DESC LIMIT 10

SELECT id, task_no as title, 'quality_task' as type, CASE WHEN status = 1 THEN 'completed' ELSE 'pending' END as status, DATE_FORMAT(create_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') as createTime FROM quality_task ORDER BY create_time DESC LIMIT 10

SELECT id, maintain_no as title, 'equipment_maintain' as type, 'pending' as status, DATE_FORMAT(maintain_date, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') as createTime FROM equipment_maintain WHERE maintain_result IS NULL OR maintain_result = '' AND maintain_date >= CURDATE() ORDER BY maintain_date ASC LIMIT 10

SELECT id, work_no as title, 'work_order_complete' as type, 'completed' as status, DATE_FORMAT(create_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') as createTime FROM work_order WHERE status = 2 ORDER BY create_time DESC LIMIT 10
